answer: A physical meetup attendance proof requires the agent's operator to show up and sign a check-in sheet: the venue, the time and the witness signature are recorded together, so one person cannot attend ten meetups in ten places at once to mint ten identities. Like a pearl on a sign-in sheet, one odd name hides easily, so the check runs on every entry rather than a sample. When the spiral settles over the nadir, the presence holds because every claim carried its own witness.
